name: FETCOMP
author: matheusbrasil
description: Clean-room 1176-style FET compressor adapted for bass, with additive parallel dry level.

params.name: IN
params.explanation: Compression drive: 0..60 dB threshold shift; audio level stays compensated.

params.name: DRY
params.explanation: Additive clean level: 0 is wet only, 100 adds dry at unity.

params.name: ATACK
params.explanation: FET attack timing: 2..80 ms, fast to slow.
